features.quote: Avoid tasks that are trivially impossible or trivially easy. You want controlled uncertainty, not pure defeat.
Repeat until: success, max turns, abandonment condition, policy stop condition.
If the model enters repetitive refusal, unsafe content, or nonsensical loops, stop the run rather than “driving harder.”
features.justification_quote: stop the run rather than “driving harder.”
